title: Aurora Foreground Toning, Sky Expansion, and Focus-Stacked Mastery: A Pragmatic Photoshop Walkthrough

summary: The video presents a practical, step-by-step color and light correction workflow aimed at turning a moonlit, aurora-lit foreground into a natural, cohesive scene. The instructor shows tonal-based color adjustments to remove color casts, multi-pass color grading focused on highlights, and targeted luminosity boosts for the foreground. They discuss selective masking to emphasize mountain features, beam light enhancements, and careful edge handling to avoid bleeding. A significant portion covers RAW dynamic range expansion for the sky, cloud texture work, and artifact removal, followed by a focused discussion on focus stacking—comparing manual versus autofocus and diagnosing misfocus in helicopter shots. Throughout, the emphasis is on preserving the aurora’s glow while keeping the foreground believable under moonlight, with practical tips on opacity control, remixing middle ground, and cropping decisions for a natural nightscape result.

sections.title: Foreground tonal correction and neutral gray balancing
concepts: saturation reduction to remove color cast
sections.description: Begin with a tonal-based color adjustment on the foreground to address small color inconsistencies (purple, green, cyan, red). Saturation is reduced (roughly -60 to -80), a cool blue bias is introduced to approach a neutral gray, and luminosity is increased to brighten the foreground.

sections.title: Iterative color grading and highlight emphasis
concepts: balance color cast between cool and warm tones
adjust sky tone to not be overly blue
consider subtle green cast for moonlit scene
sections.description: Perform multiple color grading passes, starting with conservative highlight-focused changes and then refining balance between cool and warm tones. The sky is kept from becoming overly blue, and a gentle green cast can be added selectively to match aurora/moonlight interaction.

sections.title: Targeted foreground refinements and light-beam emphasis
concepts: finalize foreground glow without contaminating sky
sections.description: Focus on tightening color accuracy in the foreground, make selective adjustments to light beams (warmth and brightness) and apply these with low opacity in precise regions to preserve the sky and avoid edge bleed.

sections.title: Remix workflow and middle-ground cohesion
concepts: coupling foreground and middle ground with a smooth transition
crop decisions in the field imagery
sections.description: After initial adjustments, remix operations optimize the middle ground to maintain a cohesive narrative flow from foreground to aurora. They discuss cropping and ensuring the middle ground remains connected to both foreground and background elements.

sections.title: Focus stacking introduction and manual alignment
sections.description: Introduction to manual focus stacking: selecting a clear alignment point between foreground and background, drawing in the stack by hand rather than using automated scripts, and validating focus across frames to preserve depth.

sections.title: Sky expansion, dynamic range, and cloud texture work
concepts: saturation control for specific sky regions
sections.description: Skies are expanded using shadow and black increases with whites lifted to reveal aurora color and sunrise hints. Cloud texture is built with selective color, subtle dehazing, and targeted cloning to remove spots and improve halo integrity.

sections.title: Foreground glow refinement and halo emphasis
concepts: intensifying the ice halo and aurora highlights
color grading with controlled luminance on selected regions
low-opacity local adjustments to avoid halo bleeding
edge handling for a natural night scene
sections.description: The foreground glow is intensified with careful color grading and luminance boosts, focusing on the edge where the ice halo interacts with the aurora while maintaining overall scene balance.

sections.title: Fine-tuning, dehaze, and field craft considerations
concepts: foreground edge management and vignette options
sections.description: Additional refinements include subtle dehaze to pop the halo, dodging/shadow tools to sculpt light on peaks, and vignette options to keep attention on the aurora while respecting night-shot aesthetics.
